question: Based on monthly sales data starting in January 2016 and using a centered moving average to adjust for seasonality, which products had a seasonality-adjusted sales ratio that stayed consistently above 2 for every month in the year 2017?
sql:
WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        CAST(SUBSTR(mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        CAST(SUBSTR(mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) as month_num,
        qty
    FROM monthly_sales
),
with_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        year,
        month_num,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year * 100 + month_num) as rn
    FROM monthly_data
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        w1.product_id,
        w1.mth,
        w1.year,
        w1.month_num,
        w1.qty,
        AVG(w2.qty) as cma
    FROM with_rank w1
    JOIN with_rank w2 
        ON w1.product_id = w2.product_id
        AND w2.rn BETWEEN w1.rn - 6 AND w1.rn + 5
    GROUP BY w1.product_id, w1.mth, w1.year, w1.month_num, w1.qty
),
ratio_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        year,
        month_num,
        qty,
        cma,
        qty / NULLIF(cma, 0) as ratio
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE year = 2017
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) as months_above_2,
    MIN(ratio) as min_ratio,
    MAX(ratio) as max_ratio
FROM ratio_calc
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING MIN(ratio) > 2
